description: Conversation across turns: follow-ups, memory, and self-correction. Each turn is sent with the full history so far.
name: Multi-turn

turns.prompt: Remember this: the code word is BANANA. Just say you will remember it.
What is the code word?
I have 3 cats and 1 dog. Remember that.
How many pets do I have in total?
What is 17 + 25?
That is wrong. What is 17 + 25 really? Work it out again.
My favourite colour is green.
What is my favourite colour?
I am planning a trip to Lisbon next summer.
Where am I planning to go on my trip?
My name is Elena. Remember that.
What is my name?
Start with the number 10. Remember it.
Add 5 to that number. What is the result?
I live in Madrid now.
Where do I live?
I have a brother named Tom and a sister named Ana. Remember them.
What are the names of my brother and sister?
How many days are in a week?
Are you sure? Think again: how many days are in a week?
